rows.label: GLOSS
rows.clue: An explanation or definition of an obscure word in a text

rows.label: FIRST PERSON
rows.clue: Pronouns and verbs used to refer to the speaker or writer of the language in which they occur

rows.label: BREVET
rows.clue: A document entitling a commissioned officer to hold a higher rank temporarily (but without higher pay)

rows.label: SPOONERISM
rows.clue: Transposition of initial consonants in a pair of words

rows.label: RATIFICATION
rows.clue: Making something valid by formally ratifying or confirming it

rows.label: DOTTED LINE
rows.clue: A line made up of dots or dashes

rows.label: FOREWARNING
rows.clue: An early warning about a future event

rows.label: PERFORMANCE
rows.clue: A dramatic or musical entertainment

rows.label: QUESTIONNAIRE
rows.clue: A form containing a set of questions

rows.label: BUSINESS NEWS
rows.clue: News about businesses and investments

rows.label: PREAMBLE
rows.clue: A preliminary introduction to a statute or constitution (usually explaining its purpose)

rows.label: FINGER SCAN
rows.clue: Biometric identification by automatically scanning a person's fingerprints electronically

rows.label: ARGUING
rows.clue: A contentious speech act

rows.label: JOINT RETURN
rows.clue: A return filed by a husband and wife

rows.label: PASSING NOTE
rows.clue: A nonharmonic note inserted for transition between harmonic notes

rows.label: NATIONAL FLAG
rows.clue: An emblem flown as a symbol of nationality

rows.label: RHAPSODY
rows.clue: An epic poem adapted for recitation

rows.label: UNIVERSAL
rows.clue: (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages

rows.label: QUESTION MARK
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (?) placed at the end of a sentence to indicate a question

rows.label: AFFIDAVIT
rows.clue: Written declaration made under oath

rows.label: CAVEAT
rows.clue: A warning against certain acts

rows.label: INTAGLIO
rows.clue: A printing process that uses an etched or engraved plate

rows.label: MARCHING MUSIC
rows.clue: Genre of music written for marching

rows.label: GOOD AUTHORITY
rows.clue: Testimony by someone who should know

rows.label: LINE SCORE
rows.clue: A summary of the scoring in a game (usually in tabular form)

rows.label: BERATING
rows.clue: A severe rebuke

rows.label: WHOLE NAME
rows.clue: A word that names the whole of which a given word is a part

rows.label: CRITICISM
rows.clue: Disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings

rows.label: SIDEBAR
rows.clue: (law) a courtroom conference between the lawyers and the judge that is held out of the jury's hearing

rows.label: STORYBOOK
rows.clue: A book containing a collection of stories (usually for children)

rows.label: ORDER BOOK
rows.clue: A printed copy of the order of the day

rows.label: TELLING
rows.clue: An act of narration

rows.label: EIGHTH NOTE
rows.clue: A musical note having the time value of an eighth of a whole note

rows.label: STOCK INDEX
rows.clue: Index based on a statistical compilation of the share prices of a number of representative stocks

rows.label: STEM VOWEL
rows.clue: A vowel that ends a stem and precedes an inflection

rows.label: SIMULCAST
rows.clue: A broadcast that is carried simultaneously by radio and television (or by FM and AM radio)

rows.label: EXPRESS
rows.clue: Mail that is distributed by a rapid and efficient system

rows.label: MUSICAL DRAMA
rows.clue: Opera in which the musical and dramatic elements are equally important

rows.label: BABY TALK
rows.clue: An adult's imitation of the speech of a young child

rows.label: PRAGMATIC
rows.clue: An imperial decree that becomes part of the fundamental law of the land

rows.label: TITLE DEED
rows.clue: A legal document proving a person's right to property

rows.label: PROFESSING
rows.clue: An open avowal (true or false) of some belief or opinion

rows.label: BOAST
rows.clue: Speaking of yourself in superlatives

rows.label: FREE PRESS
rows.clue: A press not restricted or controlled by government censorship regarding politics or ideology

rows.label: POSTAGE STAMP
rows.clue: A small adhesive token stuck on a letter or package to indicate that that postal fees have been paid

rows.label: REGGAE
rows.clue: Popular music originating in the West Indies

rows.label: SIBILANT
rows.clue: A consonant characterized by a hissing sound (like s or sh)

rows.label: SMEAR
rows.clue: Slanderous defamation

rows.label: FARCE
rows.clue: A comedy characterized by broad satire and improbable situations

rows.label: DISSERTATION
rows.clue: A treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research

rows.label: SPORTS SECTION
rows.clue: The section of a newspaper that reports on sports

rows.label: ESSAY
rows.clue: An analytic or interpretive literary composition

rows.label: CATALOG
rows.clue: A book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things

rows.label: CARICATURE
rows.clue: A representation of a person that is exaggerated for comic effect

rows.label: INSTIGATION
rows.clue: The verbal act of urging on

rows.label: AFFIRMATIVE
rows.clue: A reply of affirmation

rows.label: LECTURE
rows.clue: A speech that is open to the public

rows.label: PROMULGATION
rows.clue: A public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen

rows.label: SONATA
rows.clue: A musical composition of 3 or 4 movements of contrasting forms

rows.label: ETIQUETTE
rows.clue: Rules governing socially acceptable behavior

rows.label: RETORT
rows.clue: A quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)

rows.label: STYLE SHEET
rows.clue: A sheet summarizing the editorial conventions to be followed in preparing text for publication

rows.label: FLASH CARD
rows.clue: A card with words or numbers or pictures that is flashed to a class by the teacher

rows.label: BACKGROUNDER
rows.clue: A press conference or interview in which a government official explains to reporters the background of an action or policy

rows.label: PIDGIN
rows.clue: An artificial language used for trade between speakers of different languages

rows.label: SICK LIST
rows.clue: A list of those who are ill (e.g. on a warship or in a regiment etc)

rows.label: REVIEW ARTICLE
rows.clue: An essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play)

rows.label: SOURCE PROGRAM
rows.clue: A program written in a language from which statements are translated into machine language

rows.label: CONVERSATION
rows.clue: The use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.

rows.label: SCRIPT
rows.clue: A written version of a play or other dramatic composition

rows.label: QUARTER NOTE
rows.clue: A musical note having the time value of a quarter of a whole note

rows.label: PROTECTIONISM
rows.clue: The policy of imposing duties or quotas on imports in order to protect home industries from overseas competition

rows.label: TONE SYSTEM
rows.clue: The system of tones used in a particular language or dialect of a tone language

rows.label: BARGAINING
rows.clue: The negotiation of the terms of a transaction or agreement

rows.label: TRADING STAMP
rows.clue: A token resembling a stamp given by a retailer to a buyer

rows.label: STAGE WHISPER
rows.clue: A loud whisper that can be overheard

rows.label: CONSPECTUS
rows.clue: An overall summary

rows.label: PINK SLIP
rows.clue: Official notice that you have been fired from your job

rows.label: SECTION
rows.clue: A self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)

rows.label: LEGISLATION
rows.clue: Law enacted by a legislative body

rows.label: AUDIO
rows.clue: The audible part of a transmitted signal

rows.label: DISCOURSE
rows.clue: Extended verbal expression in speech or writing

rows.label: SIGNING
rows.clue: Language expressed by visible hand gestures

rows.label: MAIDEN NAME
rows.clue: A woman's surname before marriage

rows.label: AMPERSAND
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (&) used to represent conjunction (and)

rows.label: TENSE SYSTEM
rows.clue: A system of tenses used in a particular language

rows.label: SMALL CAPITAL
rows.clue: A character having the form of an upper-case letter but the same height as lower-case letters

rows.label: PROGRAM LINE
rows.clue: (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program

rows.label: MARGIN CALL
rows.clue: A demand by a broker that a customer deposit enough to bring his margin up to the minimum requirement

rows.label: POUND SIGN
rows.clue: A symbol for a unit of currency (especially for the pound sterling in Great Britain)

rows.label: GUARANTEE
rows.clue: A written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications

rows.label: PASSWORD
rows.clue: A secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group

rows.label: CONDOLENCE
rows.clue: An expression of sympathy with another's grief

rows.label: LYRIC
rows.clue: The text of a popular song or musical-comedy number

rows.label: MOTION
rows.clue: The use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals

rows.label: DISCUSSION
rows.clue: An extended communication (often interactive) dealing with some particular topic
